_note: LONG-TASK OFFLOAD. This is not a script-mind plan — submit it with mind "http" (CLI: swarm.mjs job submit --plan examples/long-task.json --mind http, or SDK submitJob({mind:"http"})). The worker hands this whole object to the model as its task brief; the model then works through REAL tools (fs/shell/git/swarm), every call grant-checked and receipted. Requires KILN_MIND_URL in the DAEMON's environment (workers inherit it) — without it the http mind REFUSES LOUDLY instead of pretending. See swarm/README.md. "steps" is [] because the submission gate requires plan.steps[]; the http mind gets the whole object as its brief.
constraints: Work only inside the work dir — the tool jail enforces this anyway.
Commit finished work with git.commit (needs CAP_COMMIT on the node).
If the task cannot be completed, say so in the final summary instead of faking it.
deliverable: The observable end state: files written, tests green, a commit hash — whatever 'done' means for this task.
task: Describe the long task here. Be concrete: what should exist when the work is done, and how to verify it.
